resources.string: Enter a numeric IPv4 or IPv6 address and a port between 1 and 65535.

Connect to an existing VNC server on your LAN or VPN. Touch controls the left mouse button; a mouse supports right-click, dragging and scrolling. Click the desktop to use a physical keyboard. Audio, clipboard and IME input are not supported.
Supports no authentication or traditional VNC passwords only (up to 8 Latin-1 characters). Traffic is not encrypted; use a trusted LAN or VPN. TLS/VeNCrypt is not supported.
